+"""Standalone copy of Click's Windows ANSI stream wrapping.
+
+This module can be imported by file path without importing Click. It
+vendors ``auto_wrap_for_ansi`` from ``click._compat`` as
+:func:`vendored_ansi_stream`, together with the private helpers it uses.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import io
+import sys
+import typing as t
+from weakref import WeakKeyDictionary
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_ansi_stream", "vendored_ansi_stream_variant"]
+
+
+class _NonClosingTextIOWrapper(io.TextIOWrapper):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        stream: t.BinaryIO,
+        encoding: str | None,
+        errors: str | None,
+        force_readable: bool = False,
+        force_writable: bool = False,
+        **extra: t.Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._stream = stream = t.cast(
+            t.BinaryIO, _FixupStream(stream, force_readable, force_writable)
+        )
+        super().__init__(stream, encoding, errors, **extra)
+
+    def __del__(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            self.detach()
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+
+    def isatty(self) -> bool:
+        # https://bitbucket.org/pypy/pypy/issue/1803
+        return self._stream.isatty()
+
+
+class _FixupStream:
+    """The new io interface needs more from streams than streams
+    traditionally implement.  As such, this fix-up code is necessary in
+    some circumstances.
+
+    The forcing of readable and writable flags are there because some tools
+    put badly patched objects on sys (one such offender are certain version
+    of jupyter notebook).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        stream: t.BinaryIO,
+        force_readable: bool = False,
+        force_writable: bool = False,
+    ):
+        self._stream = stream
+        self._force_readable = force_readable
+        self._force_writable = force_writable
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> t.Any:
+        return getattr(self._stream, name)
+
+    def read1(self, size: int) -> bytes:
+        f = getattr(self._stream, "read1", None)
+
+        if f is not None:
+            return t.cast(bytes, f(size))
+
+        return self._stream.read(size)
+
+    def readable(self) -> bool:
+        if self._force_readable:
+            return True
+        x = getattr(self._stream, "readable", None)
+        if x is not None:
+            return t.cast(bool, x())
+        try:
+            self._stream.read(0)
+        except Exception:
+            return False
+        return True
+
+    def writable(self) -> bool:
+        if self._force_writable:
+            return True
+        x = getattr(self._stream, "writable", None)
+        if x is not None:
+            return t.cast(bool, x())
+        try:
+            self._stream.write(b"")
+        except Exception:
+            try:
+                self._stream.write(b"")
+            except Exception:
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def seekable(self) -> bool:
+        x = getattr(self._stream, "seekable", None)
+        if x is not None:
+            return t.cast(bool, x())
+        try:
+            self._stream.seek(self._stream.tell())
+        except Exception:
+            return False
+        return True
+
+
+def _is_jupyter_kernel_output(stream: t.IO[t.Any]) -> bool:
+    while isinstance(stream, (_FixupStream, _NonClosingTextIOWrapper)):
+        stream = stream._stream
+
+    return stream.__class__.__module__.startswith("ipykernel.")
+
+
+def should_strip_ansi(
+    stream: t.IO[t.Any] | None = None, color: bool | None = None
+) -> bool:
+    if color is None:
+        if stream is None:
+            stream = sys.stdin
+        return not isatty(stream) and not _is_jupyter_kernel_output(stream)
+    return not color
+
+
+def isatty(stream: t.IO[t.Any]) -> bool:
+    try:
+        return stream.isatty()
+    except Exception:
+        return False
+
+
+_ansi_stream_wrappers: cabc.MutableMapping[t.TextIO, t.TextIO] = WeakKeyDictionary()
+
+
+def vendored_ansi_stream(stream: t.TextIO, color: bool | None = None) -> t.TextIO:
+    """Support ANSI color and style codes on Windows by wrapping a
+    stream with colorama.
+    """
+    try:
+        cached = _ansi_stream_wrappers.get(stream)
+    except Exception:
+        cached = None
+
+    if cached is not None:
+        return cached
+
+    import colorama
+
+    strip = should_strip_ansi(stream, color)
+    ansi_wrapper = colorama.AnsiToWin32(stream, strip=strip)
+    rv = t.cast(t.TextIO, ansi_wrapper.stream)
+    _write = rv.write
+
+    def _safe_write(s: str) -> int:
+        try:
+            return _write(s)
+        except BaseException:
+            ansi_wrapper.reset_all()
+            raise
+
+    rv.write = _safe_write  # type: ignore[method-assign]
+
+    try:
+        _ansi_stream_wrappers[stream] = rv
+    except Exception:
+        pass
+
+    return rv
+
+
+def vendored_ansi_stream_variant(
+    stream: t.TextIO, color: bool | None = False
+) -> t.TextIO:
+    """Like :func:`vendored_ansi_stream`, but ``color`` defaults to
+    ``False`` instead of ``None``. Explicit values are passed through.
+    """
+    return vendored_ansi_stream(stream, color)

+++ b/tests/test_standalone_wave6_ansi_stream.py
@@ -0,0 +1,170 @@
+import importlib.util
+import io
+import sys
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_wave6_ansi_stream.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def mod(monkeypatch):
+    for name in list(sys.modules):
+        if name == "click" or name.startswith("click."):
+            monkeypatch.delitem(sys.modules, name)
+
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_ansi_stream", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    assert "click" not in sys.modules
+    assert "click._compat" not in sys.modules
+    return module
+
+
+class FakeAnsiToWin32:
+    instances = []
+
+    def __init__(self, wrapped, strip=None):
+        self.wrapped = wrapped
+        self.strip = strip
+        self.stream = io.StringIO()
+        self.reset_count = 0
+        FakeAnsiToWin32.instances.append(self)
+
+    def reset_all(self):
+        self.reset_count += 1
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def colorama(monkeypatch):
+    FakeAnsiToWin32.instances = []
+    fake = types.ModuleType("colorama")
+    fake.AnsiToWin32 = FakeAnsiToWin32
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "colorama", fake)
+    return fake
+
+
+class TTYStream(io.StringIO):
+    def __init__(self, tty):
+        super().__init__()
+        self._tty = tty
+
+    def isatty(self):
+        return self._tty
+
+
+def test_exports(mod):
+    assert mod.__all__ == ["vendored_ansi_stream", "vendored_ansi_stream_variant"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("tty", "color", "strip"),
+    [
+        (True, None, False),
+        (False, None, True),
+        (False, True, False),
+        (True, False, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vendored_strip_decision(mod, colorama, tty, color, strip):
+    stream = TTYStream(tty)
+    rv = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(stream, color)
+    (wrapper,) = FakeAnsiToWin32.instances
+    assert wrapper.wrapped is stream
+    assert wrapper.strip is strip
+    assert rv is wrapper.stream
+
+
+def test_vendored_default_color_is_none(mod, colorama):
+    mod.vendored_ansi_stream(TTYStream(True))
+    assert FakeAnsiToWin32.instances[0].strip is False
+
+
+def test_vendored_isatty_error_strips(mod, colorama):
+    class Broken(io.StringIO):
+        def isatty(self):
+            raise OSError("no terminal")
+
+    mod.vendored_ansi_stream(Broken())
+    assert FakeAnsiToWin32.instances[0].strip is True
+
+
+def test_vendored_jupyter_stream_not_stripped(mod, colorama):
+    class Kernel(io.StringIO):
+        pass
+
+    Kernel.__module__ = "ipykernel.iostream"
+    mod.vendored_ansi_stream(Kernel())
+    assert FakeAnsiToWin32.instances[0].strip is False
+
+
+def test_vendored_caches_wrapper(mod, colorama):
+    stream = TTYStream(True)
+    first = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(stream)
+    assert mod.vendored_ansi_stream(stream, False) is first
+    assert len(FakeAnsiToWin32.instances) == 1
+
+
+def test_vendored_unhashable_stream_not_cached(mod, colorama):
+    class Unhashable(TTYStream):
+        __hash__ = None
+
+    stream = Unhashable(True)
+    first = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(stream)
+    second = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(stream)
+    assert first is not second
+    assert len(FakeAnsiToWin32.instances) == 2
+
+
+def test_vendored_empty_write(mod, colorama):
+    rv = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(TTYStream(True))
+    assert rv.write("") == 0
+    assert rv.getvalue() == ""
+    assert rv.write("\x1b[31mhi") == 7
+
+
+def test_vendored_write_error_resets(mod, colorama):
+    rv = mod.vendored_ansi_stream(TTYStream(True))
+    rv.close()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        rv.write("x")
+    assert FakeAnsiToWin32.instances[0].reset_count == 1
+
+
+def test_vendored_missing_colorama(mod, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "colorama", None)
+    with pytest.raises(ImportError):
+        mod.vendored_ansi_stream(TTYStream(True))
+
+
+def test_variant_defaults_to_strip(mod, colorama):
+    stream = TTYStream(True)
+    rv = mod.vendored_ansi_stream_variant(stream)
+    (wrapper,) = FakeAnsiToWin32.instances
+    assert wrapper.strip is True
+    assert rv is wrapper.stream
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("color", "strip"), [(True, False), (None, False)])
+def test_variant_forwards_explicit_color(mod, colorama, color, strip):
+    mod.vendored_ansi_stream_variant(TTYStream(True), color)
+    assert FakeAnsiToWin32.instances[0].strip is strip
+
+
+def test_variant_empty_write_and_cache(mod, colorama):
+    stream = TTYStream(False)
+    rv = mod.vendored_ansi_stream_variant(stream)
+    assert rv.write("") == 0
+    assert mod.vendored_ansi_stream_variant(stream, True) is rv
+
+
+def test_variant_missing_colorama(mod, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "colorama", None)
+    with pytest.raises(ImportError):
+        mod.vendored_ansi_stream_variant(TTYStream(True))
notes:
Copied the Windows-branch auto_wrap_for_ansi verbatim as vendored_ansi_stream, along with its weak-key cache, should_strip_ansi, isatty, _is_jupyter_kernel_output and the _NonClosingTextIOWrapper/_FixupStream classes; vendored_ansi_stream_variant only changes the color default to False. Tests load the file by path with a fake colorama and check that click is never imported.
